limitations: Deck condition changes the whole subsequent trajectory; not a randomized test of choosing to play one card.
Public relaxed path cost is a strength proxy; distinct leaders/trailers and games surviving landmarks differ by condition.
Paired seed bootstrap preserves correlation within one seed; finite samples and multiple exploratory outcomes cannot prove equivalence.
Six seat permutations with rotating first player and axes, not their full Cartesian product.
Optional timed/event games are separate from the default estimate.
